flags.why: This debt sense means handing over property to repay a debt, rather than offering collateral for a new loan ([dictionary](https://vietnamthuquan.eu/TacPham/tu-dien-tieng-viet-1713/chuong-18)).
flags.fix: to hand over property in repayment of a debt; ex: Anh ta gạt chiếc xe máy để trả nợ. = He handed over his motorbike to repay the debt.

flags.why: The entry omits the everyday Southern meaning 'to build', commonly heard in 'cất nhà' ([reference](https://www.vjol.info/cat-co-nghia-la-gi)).
flags.fix: verb [Southern] | to build (a house); ex: Gia đình tôi đang cất nhà mới. = My family is building a new house.
